prerequisites: Linear algebra (can be studied in parallel)

learning_outcomes.text: visualise results of computations and data sets by self-explaining graphics.
construct simple scripts and functions and use control structures (if-statements, for- and while-loops) to solve more advance project tasks.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to programming in MATLAB, using elementary methods
Advantages in documentation and comments to code
Plots and visualisation of computational results
Numerical calculations in linear algebra (e.g. to solve linear equation systems)
Solving basic engineering problems by dividing these into subproblems
assessment_rules: Computer-based lab sessions, consisting of a smaller plot assignment and a slightly larger project assignment, and submission of project code to Urkund. Grades are given as ‘Fail’ or ‘Pass’. Grades for examination modules are decided in accordance with the assessment criteria presented at the start of the course.
degree: Industrial Engineering and Management - International (6CIEI), terms 1-6 (first cycle)
